description: Indulge in the velvety smooth texture and rich, nutty flavor of this authentic Classic Hummus Tahini Olive Oil. Made with creamy chickpeas, bright lemon, savory tahini, and a generous drizzle of golden olive oil, this traditional Middle Eastern dip is a true culinary delight. Perfect as a healthy appetizer or a versatile accompaniment to any meal, it promises a taste of the Levant in every scoop.

ingredients.notes: drained, rinsed, skins removed if desired (reserve 1/4 cup liquid)

instructions.title: Prepare Chickpeas
instructions.text: Drain the canned chickpeas, reserving about 1/4 cup of the liquid. For an extra smooth hummus, gently pinch and remove the outer skins from the chickpeas. This step is optional but highly recommended for the silkiest texture.

instructions.title: Make Tahini Sauce
instructions.text: In a food processor, combine the tahini, fresh lemon juice, and minced garlic. Process for 1-2 minutes until the mixture lightens in color and thickens slightly. This creates a fluffy tahini base.

instructions.title: Add Chickpeas and Seasoning
instructions.text: Add the peeled chickpeas, ground cumin, and salt to the tahini mixture in the food processor. Process for 3-5 minutes, scraping down the sides occasionally, until the mixture starts to become smooth.

instructions.title: Achieve Creamy Consistency
instructions.text: With the food processor running, slowly drizzle in 2-4 tablespoons of ice cold water (or the reserved chickpea liquid), one tablespoon at a time, until the hummus reaches your desired creamy and light consistency. The cold water helps emulsify the mixture.

instructions.title: Final Blend and Taste
instructions.text: Continue to process for another 2-3 minutes, ensuring the hummus is perfectly smooth and airy. Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more salt or lemon juice if needed. For extra richness, you can blend in 1 tablespoon of olive oil at this stage.

instructions.title: Serve and Garnish
instructions.text: Transfer the hummus to a shallow serving bowl. Create a swirl on top with the back of a spoon, then generously drizzle with extra virgin olive oil. Sprinkle with paprika and fresh chopped parsley before serving with warm pita bread, fresh vegetables, or as part of a mezze platter.

tips: For the truly authentic, silkiest hummus, take the time to peel the skins off each chickpea. While tedious, it makes a significant difference in texture and creaminess.
Always use good quality tahini; fresh, creamy tahini with a light color and pourable consistency will yield the best flavor and texture for your hummus.
Hummus tastes even better after resting for an hour in the refrigerator, allowing the flavors to meld. Serve at room temperature for optimal creaminess and aroma.
